Stannis’s former squire led Edric Storm’s escort into exile, helping Davos keep the boy beyond Melisandre’s reach.

Aegon IV’s Hand and the first lord of Whitewalls. The dragon egg he received from the king later became a tourney prize.
Ambrose Butterwell's unnamed father. Both Ambrose and his paternal grandfather served as Hand of the King; no separate account of the intervening generation survives.

Anders Yronwood's unnamed brother was the father of Ser Archibald, who accompanied Quentyn Martell to Essos. His descent from Ormond Yronwood is not established.

Quentyn Martell fell for the blonde, blue-eyed Ynys when he first arrived at Yronwood as a ward, but never told her. She later married Ryon Allyrion, heir to Godsgrace, and they have at least two sons.
